Simulation data from the Kang paper

Source: R/sim_data.R
gen_df_kang.Rd

A DGP for simulation studies.

Usage

gen_df_kang(n = 1000)

Arguments

n

Number of samples to generate

Value

A data frame with covariates and outcome

Details

Generates a 4 dimensional multivariate normal that then gets transformed to generate four "X" variables. The Outcome is a function of the original V variables.

Examples

dat <- gen_df_kang(n = 200)
dim(dat)
#> [1] 200  12
